title: Does Recursive Knowledge Construction Help Agents Verify Consensus Claims in Science?
abstract: arXiv:2610.40906v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent scientific agents build knowledge recursively by retrieving evidence, constructing an intermediate state, and judging whether that state contains sufficient information. These agents are evaluated end-to-end, usually without ground truth, so the effect of each design choice is unknown. Here, we examined two design axes: (1) what the recursion builds (the state of evidence) and (2) what controls it (the judge that decides when to stop). To measure them, we defined consensus scientific claim verification and measured these effects on this task, where a system must establish a claim's consensus stance from the open literature. We built a new consensus claim dataset, ProClaim-eval, including 718 claims with SUPPORT and REFUTE gold labels from five expert-curated databases spanning molecular biology, nuclear physics, and astronomy. translated_title: 递归知识构建能帮助智能体验证科学共识性主张吗？
translated_abstract: 最近的科学智能体通过检索证据、构建中间状态并判断该状态是否包含足够信息来递归地构建知识。这些智能体通常在没有真实标准答案的情况下进行端到端评估，因此每个设计选择的效果都是未知的。本文考察了两个设计维度：(1) 递归所构建的内容（证据状态）以及 (2) 控制递归的机制（决定何时停止的裁判）。为了测量它们的作用，作者定义了共识性科学主张验证任务并在该任务上测量这些影响，在该任务中，系统必须从开放文献中确立一个主张的共识立场。作者构建了一个新的共识主张数据集 ProClaim-eval，包含 718 条带有 SUPPORT 和 REFUTE 金标准标签的主张，这些标签来自五个由专家整理的数据库，涵盖分子生物学、核物理学和天文学。作者的工具 ProClaim 将证据状态保存在模型上下文之外，从而使每个设计维度都可以被单独研究。
tldr: 该论文提出共识性科学主张验证任务，构建了含 718 条带专家标注的数据集 ProClaim-eval，并设计了将证据状态外置于模型上下文的 ProClaim 系统，从而能够分别评估递归知识构建中“构建什么”与“何时停止”这两个设计维度的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces consensus scientific claim verification with a new 718-claim expert-labeled dataset (ProClaim-eval) and the ProClaim system, which persists evidence state outside the model's context to isolate the effects of the two design axes—what the recursion builds and what controls it—in recursive knowledge construction.
